account: China Telecom Cloud runs CloudTop in production across its service and marketing workflows. The system runs on China Telecom's TeleChat2 and Huize models with DeepSeek. China Telecom Cloud reported that its CloudTop marketing and service solution won a user's preferred brand award at the 23rd China IT User Satisfaction Conference in Beijing on 25 October 2024. In its submission of 2025, China Telecom Cloud reports that the coverage of knowledge compilation and quality inspection rose from 10% under manual work to 100%. It also reports 24% better service efficiency and 30% fewer night shifts. Staff from former service roles moved into data annotation. These operational and workforce figures are the company's own claims. No independent evaluation of the efficiency or night-shift figures had appeared by October 2026. No source measures wider effects on employment equity or economic growth.
